name: clear_four_strided_long_buffers
description: Zeroes two thousand longwords of a global buffer one at a time, clearing three other copies of that buffer located eight, sixteen and twenty-four thousand bytes further on within the same loop.

name: return_data_registers_unchanged
description: Performs no work and returns the incoming values of the two data registers unchanged as a pair, so callers get back what they passed in.

name: convert_field_to_word_count
description: Reads a 16-bit field from the record addressed by the address register, adds fifteen and shifts right by four, returning the number of sixteen-unit columns needed to cover that value.

name: copy_sixteen_words_fixed
description: Copies sixteen consecutive words from the block addressed by the address register, starting four bytes in, into a fixed buffer at a constant location.

name: double_words_into_global_table
description: Reads sixteen words from a fixed source buffer, doubles each one, and stores them into a global table at four-byte intervals.

name: double_record_words_strided
description: Doubles sixteen words read from the block addressed by the address register and writes them to a destination pointer at four-byte intervals, starting two bytes in.

name: fill_strided_words_with_value
description: Stores the low word of the second data register into sixteen words spaced four bytes apart, starting two bytes into the destination pointer, then returns.

name: spin_until_counter_reaches_limit
description: Loops with no other work while a global counter is less than a 16-bit limit read from the record addressed by a fixed pointer register, then returns the first data register unchanged.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is an entry that is executed but has no body.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is a second empty entry with the same form as its neighbour.

name: call_library_then_bad_data
description: Program entry fragment that calls a library routine through a global pointer, then subtracts a constant from a long run of words beginning at its own entry and stores a few values. Decoding hits invalid instruction data partway, so the tail is not recovered.

name: copy_words_then_bad_data
description: Increments a 16-bit counter, copies two words from fields of a record into two output pointers, and writes a byte into a table indexed from a register. Decoding then hits invalid instruction data, so the tail is not recovered.

name: stub_truncated_credit_text_routine
description: Recovered pseudo-code is cut off after unreachable-block warnings, so only its references are known: it refers to credit text beginning Coded and the title Zynaps, and calls two other routines. The body itself is not recovered.

name: allocate_absolute_memory_block
description: Calls the system routine that allocates memory at a fixed address and writes the interrupt enable register, and refers to a packed data file name and an emulator string. The pseudo-code body is truncated, so the exact sequence is not recovered.

name: halt_loop_unless_quotient_zero
description: Divides the second data register by sixteen and loops forever when the quotient is nonzero; otherwise it returns the first data register unchanged. The facts list a raster position register, but the pseudo-code shows no read of it.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is an entry that is executed but has no body.

name: stub_infinite_loop_trap
description: Contains only an endless loop with no other work, so it never returns once entered; its decoded instructions overlap, so it is recorded as a non-returning stub.

name: stub_infinite_loop_trap
description: Contains only an endless loop with no other work, so it never returns once entered; its decoded instructions overlap, so it is recorded as a non-returning stub.

name: setup_display_copper_and_dma
description: Disables multitasking and opens a library, then programs the display window, bitplane modulos, copper list pointer, DMA control and interrupt control. The pseudo-code is truncated, so the exact register order is not recovered.

name: invert_words_ten_byte_stride
description: Inverts a word at a moving pointer and advances the pointer ten bytes each time, repeating a count equal to the second data register divided by ten.

name: test_flag_bit_and_hang
description: Tests one bit of a global byte and calls this routine again when it is set; otherwise it enters an endless loop. The rest of the large body is not in the recovered pseudo-code.

name: step_counter_and_lower_position
description: Decrements a global countdown that cycles through four steps, then subtracts a step value from two position fields of the addressed record. When a field is at or below thirty-two, both are reset to thirty-two.

name: advance_position_with_ceiling
description: Decrements a global countdown cycling through several steps, then adds a step value from another record to two position fields, setting both to 156 once the first reaches that value.

name: dispatch_active_records_from_table
description: Picks an entry from a table of forty-four-byte records using a value returned by a called routine, applies a threshold test when a global flag is clear, then walks two fixed records and calls a different routine for each active one.

name: init_record_and_dispatch_active
description: Copies two position words from a source record into the addressed record, sets its active flag and a masked value field, then walks three fixed 44-byte records and calls routines for each active one, choosing the calls by its type byte.

name: initialize_records_from_source_position
description: Depending on a flag argument, either initializes one record from a source record's position, with fixed type, size and timing values, when a global counter allows, or checks position and flag bits and initializes up to two linked records with different type codes. Some inputs are implicit register values, so exact conditions are only partly recovered.

name: decrement_countdown_and_branch
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the addressed record; when it reaches zero it calls one routine, otherwise it calls two routines.

name: countdown_then_deactivate_record
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the addressed record; when it reaches zero it clears the record's active flag, otherwise it calls two routines.

name: mark_overlapping_rectangle_bits
description: Tests whether two bounding rectangles, each given by position and size fields, overlap on both axes. If they do, it sets one bit in each of two bit masks chosen by register values; if they are separated on either axis it returns without change.

name: clear_large_longword_buffer
description: Zeroes a buffer of 8400 longwords starting at the address register, one longword per step.

name: copy_interleaved_word_blocks
description: Copies several blocks of five-word groups from one source area into a destination, then copies interleaved word triples from a second source into a third area, and finally copies a 52-row block of triples back out with a fixed stride. All copies are plain word moves with layout set by fixed offsets.

name: call_routine_sequence
description: Passes the global value to one routine and then calls a fixed sequence of further routines, with no other work in its body.

name: wait_for_raster_table_entries
description: Walks a table of 34 two-word entries, busy-waiting until a hardware position value matches each entry, then advances a countdown and repeats until it signals completion. The background colour register is also touched according to the facts.

name: fill_table_with_stepped_values
description: Writes a fixed table of word pairs, each pair a sequence value and a running value that rises by 273 per entry, with the sequence step changing across groups of entries, and ends with two final words.

name: shift_table_on_countdown_wrap
description: Decrements a global countdown; when it goes below zero it resets it to two, shifts a table of 34 words forward by one slot, and then restores the countdown from a fixed word.

name: find_first_set_bit_record
description: Looks up a record by index in a table of 44-byte records; if its flag is set, it calls a routine for a mask, scans the set bits of that mask against a table of longwords, and returns an offset for the first matching record, or zero when no bit matches.

name: stub_no_visible_effect
description: Compares a byte field of the addressed record with a constant and returns in both cases, so it performs no visible work.

name: add_packed_decimal_score
description: Adds a four-byte packed decimal value from the source pointer into a global packed decimal counter, pair by pair with decimal correction. Its condition compares a value with itself, so the second packed decimal constant is always added, after which a flag bit is set.

name: call_routine_per_byte
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string starting two bytes into the record addressed by a fixed register, calling a routine for each byte until it reaches a zero byte, then returns zero.

name: copy_eight_longs_if_flag
description: Calls two routines, compares the global value against a fixed code, and when it matches copies eight longwords from one fixed table into another, then calls one more routine.

name: insert_entry_into_ranked_table
description: Searches a table of five 22-byte records for the first record whose value the global number does not exceed. If one is found it shifts the records below it down, writes a marker into the vacated slot, copies a fixed block and returns one; otherwise it runs a polling loop and returns zero.

name: clear_long_table_block
description: Zeroes 6016 longwords starting at a fixed table address, one longword per step.

name: read_key_codes_into_entry
description: Writes a fixed set of initial values, then loops reading key codes through called routines. Two codes reset a table, two move the selection index, and two copy the stored entries out and return after a wait; other codes are stored as characters from a lookup table. The facts list a button and disk status register, but the decoded body reads input only through called routines.

name: map_key_code_to_character
description: Maps a global key code to a character from one of three lookup tables, selected by which range the code falls in, and returns zero for codes outside the mapped ranges.

name: call_routine_chain_with_arg
description: Passes the global value to one routine and then calls a long fixed sequence of further routines, with no other work in its body.

name: reset_flag_and_copy_block
description: Clears a global flag and calls a few routines, calls one more if the flag was nonzero, then copies eight longwords from one fixed table into another before calling a final routine.

name: copy_word_groups_to_areas
description: Copies groups of four words from a source into three destination areas spaced at fixed distances apart, one row per count, advancing the row pointer after each row.

name: copy_byte_rows_by_threshold
description: Chooses one of two byte sources by comparing a global counter with a running index, copies groups of four bytes per step into two destination tables across several rows, and clears one bit of the global flag byte.

name: merge_masked_plane_entries
description: For several rows, reads a five-byte entry from a table selected by the global index, uses its first byte as a mask over four destination planes, and ORs the other four bytes into place, advancing the destination by one row each time.

name: copy_table_blocks_to_slots
description: Copies several blocks of five-word groups from fixed tables into fixed destination areas, with one destination offset chosen by the global value, calling routines between copies, and finally calls a routine eight times.

name: copy_block_and_call_repeatedly
description: Copies a block of five-word groups from a fixed source into a destination offset from the address register, then calls a routine repeatedly for a fixed number of steps.

name: call_routine_eight_times
description: Calls one routine eight times in a row and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: draw_character_glyph_rows
description: Draws one character: a space returns at once, codes one and two fill a block with cleared or set bits, and any other code looks up a glyph in a table and combines its rows into four destination planes at offsets chosen by the global value.

name: copy_indexed_block_to_slots
description: Clamps the global value to at most three, then copies a block of four-word groups from a table selected by that value into two destination areas at once, for several rows.

name: count_free_records
description: Counts how many of seven 44-byte records have a zero flag byte, and stores that count in the global variable.

name: setup_record_sequence_from_table
description: Initializes a 44-byte scratch area and several globals from a table selected by a masked input, then loops a count taken from the table, copying the scratch area into a record each time and filling position fields from a second table.

name: spawn_inactive_record_slots
description: When the global counter is above three, finds a matching string table entry and fills up to seven inactive 44-byte records in turn with default values, stepping their positions, then writes a marker byte into the entry.

name: spawn_record_wait_for_bits
description: Sets the global counter from a value in the addressed record, scans the string table for a match, fills the first free 44-byte record with default values, marks an entry byte, then calls a routine repeatedly until it returns a nonzero low-bit value, which it stores in the global counter.

name: spawn_alternate_record_and_wait
description: Follows the same pattern as a neighbouring spawn routine: sets a global counter, scans the string table, fills the first free 44-byte record with a different set of default values and type code, marks an entry byte, then calls a routine until it returns a nonzero low-bit value.

name: set_record_type_and_defaults
description: Sets a type byte of six, a size field of sixteen, moves a position field back by two, stores a fixed value in another field, and sets the active flag of the addressed record.

name: spawn_pair_in_free_group
description: When a countdown reaches zero, searches up to six groups of three 44-byte records for one whose records are all inactive, initializes two records in that group with positions and values from called routines, and resets the countdown to a value between seven and twenty-two.

name: invert_low_nibble_of_byte
description: Takes the low byte of the data register, inverts it, and returns only the low four bits of the result.

name: step_pseudo_random_generator
description: Advances a global 32-bit shift register sixteen times using a fixed feedback constant, collecting each shifted-out bit into a returned sixteen-bit value.

name: deactivate_record_outside_bounds
description: Clears the active flag of the addressed record when its two position words fall outside a rectangle bounded by the 35 to 383 and 17 to 175 ranges.

name: spawn_records_from_masked_slots
description: For each of twelve slots whose bit is set in a mask, either clears the slot's flag when its type code is special, or, when a condition holds, spawns five 44-byte records from a position table offset from the given position, then returns.

name: lookup_type_table_value
description: If the record's type byte is above a small limit, returns the second data register unchanged; otherwise returns a table word selected by the type byte, with the complement of that type byte in the upper part of the result.

name: stub_no_visible_effect
description: Compares a type byte of the addressed record with a constant and returns in both cases, so it performs no visible work.

name: advance_state_and_dispatch
description: Advances a global state counter through a small cycle, then calls a routine chosen from one of two jump tables by the state value. The jump tables did not pass the decoder's sanity check, so the dispatch targets are not recovered.

name: reset_state_and_call_routine
description: Resets a global state variable to a fixed value with a flag bit set, then calls one routine.

name: increment_clamped_state_flag
description: Increments a global counter capped at three, then sets bit two of the same byte.

name: decrement_counter_twice_clamped
description: Decrements a global counter twice, clamping the result at zero after the first step and at two after the second.

name: initialize_record_and_count_down
description: Saves the global value if it is nonzero, initializes the addressed record's flags, type code and fixed value, decrements the global counter, calls a routine, and writes the saved value back into the record.

name: activate_countdown_record
description: Returns at once if the addressed record is active; otherwise it activates it with type code fifty, decrements the global countdown, sets its size, velocity and timing fields, calls a routine, and sets a state field to twenty.

name: copy_fixed_position_to_record
description: Copies two fixed words into the first and third word fields of the addressed record.

name: update_record_state_and_countdown
description: When the record is inactive, sets its state byte to one of two values depending on a global value and a fixed byte. It then decrements the record's countdown; when the countdown reaches zero it calls a routine and decrements the global counter.

name: lookup_type_table_with_complement
description: If the record's type byte is above a small limit, returns the second data register with its upper part cleared; otherwise returns a table word selected by that type byte, combined with the complement of the type byte.

name: advance_record_animation_frames
description: Steps the record through frame states, advancing its stored state value while checking a flag and a helper call. When its countdown expires and its type code matches a set value, it clears a global and decrements the global counter.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is an entry that is executed but has no body.

name: step_direction_toward_target
description: When a countdown byte expires, reloads it and steps a six-bit direction field toward a target read from a routine, moving by a configured step size and wrapping at sixty-four, then calls a routine.

name: compute_direction_code_between
description: Compares the cell positions of two records along each axis, derives a six-bit direction code from the signs and from which axis dominates, refines it with a small stepped loop, and returns the code.

name: store_scaled_angle_components
description: Looks up two values from a table indexed by a six-bit angle, the second at a quarter-turn offset, multiplies each by a signed scale value, and stores the products in two fields of the addressed record.

name: accumulate_scaled_position_words
description: Adds a 16-bit field at one fixed offset, shifted left eight bits, into the first longword of the addressed record, and adds a second field at another fixed offset, shifted the same way, into the second longword.

name: activate_record_if_inactive
description: Returns if the addressed record is already active; otherwise it zeroes two position fields, sets a velocity-like field, activates the record with type fifty-one, decrements the global counter and copies a fixed value into the position fields.

name: reverse_and_damp_velocity
description: If the addressed record is active, either clears its lift byte or, when a flag is set and a slot entry is zero, negates and halves a velocity field and decrements a bounce counter. It then calls a routine and, for the matching type code, decrements the global counter.

name: apply_flagged_motion_step
description: Adds a signed step to one position word and another to a second, choosing each sign from bits of a flag argument, then adds both position words, shifted left eight bits, into two longword fields of the addressed record.

name: read_joystick_direction_bits
description: Builds a direction-and-fire byte in a global variable from joystick port movement and the fire button register, setting flag bits and forcing the top bit. The decoded pseudo-code clears the byte before testing it, so the joystick input is not visibly used.

name: call_three_library_functions
description: Calls three library functions through fixed offsets from a library base held in a global, storing the first result in a global variable.

name: set_flag_bits
description: ORs a fixed mask of several bits into a global flag byte and returns. The facts list an input port register, but the body only sets bits in the global byte.

name: toggle_and_copy_table_block
description: Toggles the low bit of a global value and copies a block of four-word groups from a source table chosen by that bit into two destination areas, repeating the copy over a fixed number of rows.

name: copy_table_selected_by_index
description: Copies a block of four-word groups from a table selected by the global value into two destination areas, over a fixed number of rows.

name: copy_table_to_chosen_pair
description: Copies a table of four-word groups selected by the global value into two destination areas, with the pair of destinations chosen by the argument byte.

name: cycle_type_four_record_frames
description: When the global value is zero, goes through six 44-byte records. For each active record with the matching type code it advances a frame byte through four values, wrapping to zero, and copies a table entry into one of its fields.

name: advance_record_frame_byte
description: When a global value is zero, increments the addressed record's frame byte, wrapping back to one when it reaches the global value, and copies a table entry selected by that byte into a field of the record.

name: dispatch_low_type_records
description: Complements a global flag byte, then for each active record with a type code below two calls a routine selected through a jump table by that type code.

name: advance_record_frame_when_active
description: When a global flag is nonzero, advances the addressed record's frame byte, wrapping from four back to one, and copies a table entry selected by that frame into a field of the record.

name: dispatch_low_type_records_indexed
description: For each of ten records that is active and has a type code below two, calls a routine chosen from a jump table by that type code, passing the record's index.

name: release_slot_and_deactivate
description: Decrements a byte counter in a fixed table at the index stored in the addressed record, then clears the record's active flag.

name: load_sequence_entries_from_table
description: When a string table lookup succeeds, initializes a scratch area and several globals from a table selected by a masked input, then loops a count from the table, copying the scratch area into the record and filling its position fields from a second table, with routine calls between steps.

name: check_any_free_record
description: If a routine returns nonzero, scans eight 44-byte records and returns as soon as it finds an inactive one; otherwise it simply returns.

name: branch_on_position_bounds
description: If a global flag is zero and the first position word lies outside a range of 35 to 439, calls one routine and returns; otherwise it calls two routines.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: clamp_record_field_range
description: Clamps the value at offset four of the addressed record so that it is at least 16 and, when above 175, sets it to 176.

name: step_sequence_and_dispatch_action
description: Decrements a countdown in the addressed record and, when it reaches zero, reads the next entry of a byte sequence, storing its low seven bits as the new countdown and advancing the sequence pointer. Each step then calls a routine from a jump table chosen by the low three bits of the current sequence value.

name: dispatch_by_bit_field_index
description: Calls one routine selected through a jump table by bits three to six of the second data register.

name: spawn_five_records_on_code
description: If a routine returns eight, initializes five records in a row with horizontal positions stepping by sixteen, a fixed size and active flags, then sets the global flag to one.

name: spawn_five_records_from_global
description: Initializes five records in a row, with positions starting at the global value and stepping by sixteen, a fixed size and active flags, then sets the global flag to one.

name: set_value_on_two_records
description: Calls two routines, then sets a fixed value into a field of two 44-byte records and sets their size field to one.

name: check_record_bounds_and_flag
description: If a flag bit is clear, checks two records against a horizontal range; a record outside it sets the global flag, while records inside trigger two routines. It then sets the global from two fixed words, calls routines, and clears the global.

name: refresh_paired_records_on_code
description: If a routine returns eight, marks four target records as active. For each source record, the matching target copies the source position offset by sixteen and fixed size and timing fields, or is deactivated when the source is inactive. Sets the global flag to one afterwards.

name: advance_two_step_state
description: Moves a global state from one to two and returns; for any other value it resets the global to zero.

name: update_type_two_records_bounds
description: For each active type-two record among four, calls two routines, copies its position plus sixteen and a second field into the following record slot, and deactivates the record when its horizontal position leaves the range 17 to 439.

name: reset_record_after_countdown
description: Decrements a countdown byte in a table indexed by the addressed record. When it reaches zero, resets two record fields to fixed values, clears the low bits of two position words, sets two state bytes to 128, and calls a routine.

name: dispatch_records_by_type_codes
description: For each active record among six, calls one routine when its type code is fifty, another when it is fifty-four, and another when it is fifty-five.

name: set_record_value_from_table
description: Uses a record byte as an index into a small table to get a second index, then stores the longword at that index in a second table into the record's long field at offset ten.

name: set_record_value_alt_table
description: Follows the same pattern as a neighbouring routine: uses a record byte to index a small table, then stores a longword from a second, different table into the record's long field at offset ten.

name: advance_frame_or_deactivate
description: When a global flag is zero, advances the record's frame byte. At five the record is deactivated; otherwise its long field is set from a table indexed by the previous frame.

name: double_words_into_sparse_table
description: Doubles sixteen words read from a fixed source table and stores them into a destination table at four-byte intervals.

name: double_words_into_global_slots
description: Doubles sixteen words read from a fixed table and stores them into the global variable area at four-byte intervals.

name: double_words_into_two_tables
description: Doubles sixteen words read from a fixed table and writes each result to two destinations at four-byte intervals at once.

name: double_pointer_words_to_tables
description: Doubles sixteen words read from the block addressed by the input pointer and writes each result to two destinations at four-byte intervals.

name: advance_bit_selected_record_frames
description: When a global flag is set, complements it, then for each of two bit-selected groups of six record indices, increments each record's frame byte, holding it at thirteen, and sets the record's long field from a table while the frame is in range.

name: spawn_group_of_six_records
description: Sets a bit in a global mask for a selected group, then initializes six records from a table indexed by that group. Each takes an offset position from the source record and fixed size and timing values, and the global flag is then set to one.

name: clear_and_decrement_type_fifty
description: For an active record of type fifty, clears a global value, calls a routine, then decrements that global.

name: call_routine_then_decrement
description: Calls one routine and then decrements a global counter.

name: decrement_for_type_fifty_one
description: For an active record of type fifty-one, calls one routine and decrements a global counter.

name: initialize_type_fifty_five_record
description: Sets the addressed record's type code to fifty-five, moves a position field back by three, stores a fixed value, sets its size field to sixteen and sets its active flag.

name: retype_fifty_four_records
description: Walks six records; each active record of type fifty-four is changed to type fifty, and a routine is called for it.

name: copy_table_blocks_clear_third
description: Copies blocks of entries from a source table into two destination areas, clearing a third destination area in step, over several rows, after two routine calls.

name: copy_entries_to_four_tables
description: Copies forty entries from a source table into four destination tables, each receiving a different slice of every entry, and writes zeros into a fifth table.

name: reset_global_to_zero
description: Sets and then clears a global flag value, leaving it at zero.

name: shift_active_records_and_call
description: Sets a global flag to all ones, then for each active record among five temporarily shifts its first position word by forty-eight while calling a routine with its index, restores the word, and finally clears the global.

name: unpack_run_length_rows
description: Unpacks run-length encoded words from a source table into a destination grid. Each pass fills four hundred words at a fixed stride, repeating a word for negative counts and copying literal words otherwise.

name: run_blitter_four_passes
description: Runs the blitter four times, each pass aimed at a destination a fixed plane offset further on, setting a fixed blit size and waiting for the blitter to finish each time.

name: call_routine_for_offset_records
description: Sets a global flag to all ones, then for each active record among eighteen temporarily shifts its horizontal position by thirty-two while calling a routine with its index, restores the position, and clears the global.

name: move_records_and_deactivate_offscreen
description: For each of eighteen records, if active, steps its vertical position up or down by one depending on a flag and wraps it around the range zero to 175. It then moves the horizontal position left by four or two depending on another flag, and deactivates the record when that position goes negative.

name: cycle_grid_record_frames
description: Toggles a global flag and, when it becomes zero, cycles the frame byte of each active record in a grid of eighteen through six values, setting its long field from a table offset by the record's grid position.

name: blit_clipped_record_image
description: Draws a record onto the screen by blitter when its position lies within the playfield, computing clipped source and destination offsets from its position and size, then starting blitter passes with a masked row size. The decoded body is long, so the exact clipping rules are only partly recovered.

name: cycle_indexed_table_value
description: Advances a global counter that wraps after twenty, calling a routine on each step. When the counter is zero it steps a second value through a word table, adds two, and wraps back to zero at sixteen.

name: wait_then_dispatch_and_toggle
description: Busy-waits until a global value equals a fixed negative code, calls a routine chosen from a table by that value, then toggles bit two of the global. The facts list a raster position register, but the decoded loop waits on the global value.

name: call_routine_if_result_nonzero
description: Calls one routine and, if the value it returns is nonzero, calls a second routine.

name: call_routine_eighteen_times
description: Calls one routine eighteen times in a row, then copies a result register into the global variable.

name: copy_table_row_to_planes
description: Copies eight four-word groups from a row of a fixed table into four destination planes, one word per plane. When the high bit of the argument is set the source walks backwards and fills the planes in reverse order.

name: start_blit_with_size
description: Sets blitter source, destination and size registers from its inputs, waits for the blitter to finish between writes, and starts a blit with a masked size.

name: write_fixed_count_value_pairs
description: Writes four fixed count-and-value pairs into a small table, each pair a count followed by a fixed value, and returns.

name: write_seven_count_value_pairs
description: Writes four pairs into a small table, each pair a count of seven followed by a fixed value, and returns.

name: call_routine_pass_registers_through
description: Calls one routine and returns the incoming data register values unchanged as a pair.

name: call_routine_pass_registers_through
description: Calls one routine and returns the incoming data register values unchanged as a pair.

name: update_four_channel_audio_stream
description: Advances a four-channel sound playback routine. For each channel it reads the next byte from a music stream, updates volume and sample tables, and writes volume and period values to the audio registers. A DMA enable mask is built at the end. The facts name the four channel volume registers and the DMA control register; the sequence decoding is partly obscured in the pseudo-code.

name: stub_undecoded_bit_operation

name: decompress_back_reference_stream
description: Decodes a byte-oriented compressed stream into a destination buffer. It stops when the output counter reaches zero. The routine calls an empty stub.

name: setup_disk_read_registers_alt
